## About
CoolAir is a demo AC service business for Mumbai, Thane, Navi Mumbai and Pune. Technicians are certified and background-checked (mock team). The site offers online booking with a 2-hour arrival window, a pincode coverage checker, an instant price calculator, a symptom finder, AMC maintenance plans, brand pages, city pages, reviews, a blog and a before/after cleaning gallery. All values on the site are mock data for demonstration.

## Booking & tools
- [Book a service](https://coolaiir.pages.dev/book): 5-step booking — service, AC type/brand, date + 2-hour slot, pincode check, address — confirmation with booking ID
- [Track booking](https://coolaiir.pages.dev/track-booking): look up a booking by its ID
- [Instant quote](https://coolaiir.pages.dev/get-quote): price calculator by service, AC type, brand and problem
- [Symptom finder](https://coolaiir.pages.dev/symptoms): AC not cooling, water leaking, noisy, bad smell — likely cause, fix and price
- [AMC plans](https://coolaiir.pages.dev/amc): Basic ₹1,499/yr (2 services + priority slots), Premium ₹3,499/yr (4 services + free gas top-up once)
- [Offers](https://coolaiir.pages.dev/offers): seasonal offers with expiry dates
- [Emergency AC repair](https://coolaiir.pages.dev/emergency-ac-repair): 24/7 emergency, priority within 2 hours
- [Financing](https://coolaiir.pages.dev/financing): EMI options for new AC purchase/installation (mock)
- [Warranty](https://coolaiir.pages.dev/warranty): 90-day labour warranty, up to 6 months on fitted parts, 1 year on installation workmanship
